description: Update the daily budget of a Google Ads campaign. Provide the campaign budget ID (from the campaign) and the new daily amount in dollars. Use to scale spend up or down.

campaignBudgetId.description: Numeric campaign budget ID (campaign_budget.id, from a campaign query).

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

dailyAmountUsd.description: New daily budget in USD (e.g. 50 for $50/day).

name: gads_update_campaign_budget
